Functional Requirement: The system shall allow a new user to register as either a Buyer or a Seller.
The system shall reject incomplete or duplicate registration.
The system shall authenticate users and redirect by role.
The system shall return a generic invalid-login error.
The system shall allow logged-in users to log out.
The system shall allow users to edit permitted account information.
The system shall end inactive sessions after 30 minutes.
The system shall allow sellers to create complete listings with optional images.
The system shall validate ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 checksums.
The system shall place new/materially edited listings into pending review.
The system shall allow sellers to edit their own listings.
The system shall allow sellers to remove their own listings.
The system shall label and prevent purchase of zero-stock listings.
The system shall restrict seller listing actions to their own listings.
The system shall show pending listings ordered by submission date.
The system shall publish approved listings.
The system shall reject listings with a reason.
The system shall notify sellers of moderation decisions.
The system shall flag prohibited words/phrases.
The system shall block approval of invalid ISBNs.
The system shall search published listings by title author genre or ISBN.
The system shall sort results alphabetically by title.
The system shall show a no-results message.
The system shall allow browse by genre.
The system shall display complete listing details.
The system shall exclude non-published listings from search/browse.
The system shall allow in-stock published products in a cart.
The system shall allow cart view/removal and subtotal updates.
The system shall require login before checkout.
The system shall display an itemized order summary before payment.
The system shall use payment processing without storing raw card data.
The system shall decrement stock and create a permanent order.
The system shall leave stock/orders unchanged after failed payment.
The system shall allow eligible return requests.
The system shall reject expired return requests.
The system shall require a refund reason.
The system shall notify relevant sellers of refund requests.
The system shall refund approved requests and mark orders refunded.
The system shall notify buyers of refund decisions.
The system shall show sellers their own order items and buyer shipping data.
The system shall allow processing and shipping with tracking.
The system shall notify buyers when orders ship.
The system shall allow unshipped cancellation and refund.
The system shall notify buyers of cancellation reasons.
The system shall generate and deliver digital access tokens.
The system shall notify sellers of digital fulfillment.
The system shall allow reviews only for delivered purchases.
The system shall prevent duplicate reviews.
The system shall screen reviews for prohibited content.
The system shall reject prohibited reviews with an explanation.
The system shall require a star rating.
The system shall show average and individual reviews.
The system shall allow buyers to add books to wishlists.
The system shall reject duplicate wishlist entries.
The system shall display all saved wishlist books.
The system shall allow wishlist removal with confirmation.
The system shall mark unavailable saved books without deleting them.
